channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: ‘I take full responsibility’: Full text of Jensen Huang’s letter to Nvidia employees admitting affair with Chinese spy
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to his family and colleagues after admitting infidelity, as the company’s board investigates reports of a possible foreign intelligence effort. Huang said he would cooperate, while the board affirmed its confidence in him.

item.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy; Donald Trump calls Jensen Huang ‘honorable’
item.description: Nvidia’s board is investigating reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort after he acknowledged an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom US intelligence reportedly says was recruited to spy for China. Huang has apologized to the company and his family.

item.title: From iPhones to GPUs: Redington, Ingram Micro ride the AI boom
item.description: Demand for AI servers, chips, and other data centre infrastructure is becoming a growth driver for Redington and Ingram Micro, offering a new avenue for expansion

item.title: Nvidia Board to Probe Spying Case After CEO Admits Infidelity
item.description: Nvidia Corp.’s board is launching an investigation into whether Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign espionage plot after he admitted to employees that he was unfaithful to his wife.

item.title: Canva’s layoff package wins praise on LinkedIn: 6 months’ salary, 12 months’ healthcare, free MacBook and career support
item.description: The Australian design platform's restructuring will affect 1,271 employees, or 22% of its total workforce.

item.title: Israeli carrier Israir in talks to purchase local rival Arkia
item.description: ARKIA-M

item.title: Bengaluru Metro: InMobi secures naming rights for Ibbaluru station for 30 years in ₹65 crore agreement with BMRCL
item.description: InMobi said the arrangement was part of its commitment to the Bengaluru city, where it began its journey and subsequently expanded its global operations.

item.title: Singapore Airlines' $1.6 bn cabin revamp: Bigger beds, privacy door for business class, Sanjeev Kapoor’s thalis and more
item.description: Singapore Airlines will invest more than S$2 billion to overhaul cabins across aircraft, with new products arriving from the second half of 2027. First class will feature double beds, business class privacy doors, and more than 100 updated dishes, including creations by Indian chef Sanjeev Kapoor.

item.title: Adani Energy Solutions Step-Eleven says parent has funds to support power licence for proposed Noida data centre project
item.description: Adani Energy Solutions has reportedly responded to the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (UPERC) queries saying that its parent has ₹15,155.80 crore in adjusted net worth to support a proposed ₹211 crore Noida data centre power project.&nbsp;

item.title: From campus to culinary success: How a 21-year-old Gurugram college student's cafe made ₹15 lakh in 50 days
item.description: At 21, Ananya Agarwal is balancing her final year of college with running Lume &amp; Lime, a European-style vegetarian bistro in Gurugram. The cafe serves Italian, Mexican, and Mediterranean dishes prepared authentically and reportedly earned over ₹15 lakh in its first 50 days.

item.title: More private equity, venture capital funds plan to create equity value beyond fees, carry: Fundamentum’s Ashish Kumar
item.description: Some Indian fund managers want to earn from owning valuable firms of their own, not just from fees and profit share, says Fundamentum’s Ashish Kumar. He expects four or five to try within three years, though most have no firm plans yet.

item.title: NMC Healthcare founder BR Shetty held liable for $5.4 billion fraud in Abu Dhabi - All you need to know about the case
item.description: A UAE court held NMC Health co-founder BR Shetty and former CEO Prasanth Manghat liable for knowingly participating in fraudulent trading, including concealing billions in borrowings. The court set $5.397 billion as starting point for assessing their contributions to NMC’s assets.

item.title: How SBI is steadily catching up with HDFC Bank in the margin race
item.description: The difference between the net interest margins (NIMs) of India’s largest lender and its largest private lender has shrunk consistently over the years, data analysed by Mint showed.

item.title: Costa Rica shell entity and unauthorised foreign transactions - what ED raids at CoinDCX and Delta Exchange found
item.description: ED said searches at premises linked to CoinDCX and Delta Exchange uncovered evidence of alleged FEMA violations involving crypto derivatives, tokenised foreign stocks and cross-border transactions. The agency is investigating payments in stablecoins and transfers to overseas affiliates.

item.title: Berkshire surprised with record buybacks, but pace slowed as the stock rose
item.description: Also noteworthy from the company’s third-quarter results were big revenue and earnings gains for the company’s railroad unit, BNSF, and a drop in profits for its huge insurance group.

item.title: NIT Raipur, AKSI Aerospace join hands, set-up Centre Of Excellence: What will the new partnership focus on?
item.description: NIT Raipur and AKSI Aerospace Group plan to establish a Centre of Excellence for aerospace and autonomous technologies, alongside a manufacturing facility. The partnership will connect research with industrial production, provide hands-on training, and support India’s indigenous drone capabilities.

item.title: Why Beijing blocked SoftBank’s $5.4 billion ABB Robotics deal? Setback for Masayoshi Son’s physical AI ambitions
item.description: The acquisition was expected to strengthen SoftBank’s revenue and profitability as the Japanese investment firm continues to expand its AI portfolio and awaits a potential financial boost from OpenAI’s anticipated public listing

item.title: Reliance’s Independence Power Up biscuits get a motorsport makeover with Ajith Kumar Racing
item.description: Reliance Consumer Products Ltd (RCPL) to roll out an expanded range of Independence biscuit which will be availble in nine variants. Trial packs will be rolled out across Tamil Nadu at ₹5.

item.title: Sony raises PlayStation sales forecast ahead of GTA 6 launch, reveals Marvel’s Wolverine sales figure
item.description: Sony has raised its PlayStation business sales and profit forecasts by 6%, citing stronger sales of third-party games. The company has also revealed that Marvel's Wolverine sold 2.4 million copies in its first 50 days.

item.title: Tata Steel beats Q2 profit estimates on strong demand, cost savings
item.description: Tata Steel management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first, supported by higher volumes, improved realisations and seasonally stronger demand.

item.title: Microsoft's $1 billion Amsterdam data centre project faces protests over AI infrastructure costs- details inside
item.description: More than 100 activists occupied Microsoft AI data centre construction site in Amsterdam on Nov 6 as part of a two-day campaign spanning 16 countries. Protesters have raised concerns over electricity and water consumption.

item.title: Who is Angan Guha? Ex-Wipro and Chicago Booth biz leader now CEO for Americas 2 Strategic Market Unit - Achievements
item.description: Wipro has appointed former executive Angan Guha to lead its Americas 2 Strategic Market Unit, nearly four years after he left the IT major to join Birlasoft. His return comes amid slowing revenue growth in the business.

item.title: ONGC Videsh’s eyes on two Venezuela oil projects; know what finance head Anupam Agarwal said on $500 mn dividend
item.description: ONGC Videsh, the overseas investment arm of ONGC, has over $500 million in pending dividend from its stakes in the two projects: San Cristobal and Carabobo 1 field.

item.title: Tata Power's $650 million debt battle: Why Singapore court ordered seizure, sale of shares in local firm
item.description: The latest enforcement order was issued after the SICC, on August 26, 2026, dismissed all of Tata Power's applications to set aside the arbitration awards issued in Kleros's favour.

item.title: Mukesh Ambani vs Gautam Adani: India's richest wealth race since Diwali 2025 - Who won, who lost? Wealth rise in $ bn
item.description: Gautam Adani's wealth rose by $30.8 billion to $119 billion over the past year, while Mukesh Ambani lost $16.3 billion, taking his fortune to $88.3 billion. Here's how India's richest billionaires fared.

item.title: Why Deepinder Goyal's Temple is drawing social media scrutiny
item.description: Eternal founder Deepinder Goyal’s ₹85,000 Temple wearable has drawn scrutiny from doctors over claims about brain blood flow and its unvalidated Entropy metric. Goyal says it is a fitness and wellness product, not a medical device.&nbsp;

item.title: Air purifier sales surge amid worsening AQI: Blinkit, Zepto see demand spike; Amazon sales double in a week | Details
item.description: Air-purifier sales are rising across e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms as pollution worsens and winter sets in. While demand remains strongest in Delhi-NCR, retailers are also reporting growing interest from other major cities and Tier 2 markets.

item.title: Who is Sunil D'Souza? Meet Voltas' new Chairman, his career, education and why Noel Tata is stepping down
item.description: Voltas has appointed Tata Consumer Products CEO Sunil D'Souza as Chairman from November 12, replacing Noel Tata, who retires at 70 under Tata Group governance guidelines. D'Souza brings over 30 years of experience across HUL, PepsiCo and Whirlpool.

item.title: Kirloskar-backed NBFC Arka gets ₹525 cr initial commitment from TPG’s Rise Funds
item.description: The investment could increase by another ₹275 crore, subject to Arka meeting specified business milestones and obtaining regulatory approvals.

item.title: US intelligence believes Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had relationship with 'Chinese spy': What we know
item.description: US intelligence believes Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of spying for Beijing. The allegations have triggered fresh scrutiny of Nvidia's China links and security risks.

item.title: OpenAI raises $11 billion at $1.25 trillion valuation amid concerns over AI spending and regulation
item.description: OpenAI has secured $11 billion in the first tranche of a funding round valuing it at $1.25 trillion, with the total potentially reaching $20 billion. The fundraising comes amid a tech sell-off and growing investor concerns over AI spending and regulation.

item.title: From 250,000-unit ambitions to a production wind-down: What went wrong with Elon Musk's Cybertruck?
item.description: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas factory by mid-2027 to make room for its Cybercab robotaxi. The pickup struggled to meet sales expectations despite Musk's ambitious projection.

item.title: Anthropic IPO valuation: Why investors are lowering expectations after Wall Street sell-off
item.description: Anthropic's IPO valuation expectations have fallen sharply after a Wall Street sell-off, with investors now discussing a range of $1.2 trillion to $1.3 trillion, down from earlier expectations of up to $2 trillion.

item.title: Mphasis, Coforge shine in strong Q2 for IT midcaps while Sonata faces seasonal headwinds
item.description: Mid-sized IT firms delivered mixed Q2 results amid macro headwinds, with Mphasis and Coforge posting strong growth while Sonata faced seasonal pressures.

item.title: QatarEnergy eyes NextDecade Train 6 supply in latest US LNG push, sources say
item.description: NEXT DECADE-QE/SUPPLY DEAL:QatarEnergy eyes NextDecade Train 6 supply in latest US LNG push, sources say
